method: BASELINE, added as a layer beside baseline-2026-11 (which stays untouched). Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING-kind where it does not answer); dates in one module, chapter 8A with Limitation Act 1985 s 21C in a second, cases in a third; one regulative rule (the unincorporated body's 28 days to notify the court of its related trusts, s 114E (3), MUST ... WITHIN ... LEST BREACH) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Law (Wrongs) Act 2002 (ACT), A2002-40, Republication No 77 (R77), effective 16 May 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A2002-40.txt; Limitation Act 1985 (ACT), A1985-66, R28, effective 26 November 2025, s 21C, as deposited at ../../../limitation-act-1985/registers/source-bundle/A1985-66.txt. Commencements used: s 21C 26 August 2016 (A2016-53); part 8A.3 10 December 2022 (A2022-21); part 8A.1A 13 November 2025 (A2025-32); division 8A.1A.2 16 May 2026 (A2026-7). The Civil Law (Wrongs) Regulation 2003 is not deposited: nothing prescribed is used.

focus: equivalents: the ACT's equivalents of the child abuse reforms -- no limitation period for child abuse claims (Limitation Act 1985 s 21C) and the organisational liability amendments in chapter 8A (the duty to prevent child abuse, vicarious liability, defendants for unincorporated bodies, setting aside abuse settlement agreements)
